projects.name: MAPLE
projects.desc: Manifold-Activated Pruning of Latent Experts for Sub-2-BPW MoE LLMs. Compresses Gemma 4 26B from 9.92 GB to 4.75 GB (1.48 BPW) at 45.4 tok/s on 6GB GPUs.
projects.long: MAPLE structurally prunes inactive latent experts on consumer hardware without sacrificing reasoning fidelity. Reached 65+ GitHub stars, 300+ HuggingFace downloads in 24h, and featured on Hacker News and llama.cpp discussions.

projects.name: VoxelNav
projects.desc: Real-time semantic voxel mapping system for ROS2 robots with sub-100ms latency on Jetson Nano.
projects.long: VoxelNav fuses depth/LiDAR point clouds with semantic segmentation into a sparse Bayesian 3D voxel grid, enabling obstacle-aware autonomous navigation on edge robotics hardware.

projects.name: Decision Analytics Engine
projects.desc: Enterprise causal econometrics and ML decision architecture deploying Double/Debiased ML, Level-k/QRE pricing, and spectral hypergraph attribution.
projects.long: Production B-school analytics engine benchmarking cohort retention, BG/NBD + Gamma-Gamma CLV modeling, survival analysis, and causal price elasticity across 50,000+ transactions.

projects.name: Latency Engine
projects.desc: Sub-millisecond C++20 and async Python HFT statistical arbitrage, cross-exchange spread, and delta-neutral funding engine.
projects.long: Monitors live order book feeds across venues with lock-free structures in C++20 and async Python orchestration for spread and funding-rate arbitrage.

projects.name: GhostPilot
projects.desc: GPS-denied drone navigation with Agentic AI combining VINS-Mono, Nav2, and an LLM mission parser.
projects.long: Translates natural-language mission objectives into collision-free visual-inertial waypoints for autonomous UAV flight without GPS.

projects.name: KVQuant
projects.desc: Drop-in KV cache compressor for local LLM inference, enabling 70B-class context scaling on 8GB RAM.
projects.long: Compresses key-value attention caches on the fly during autoregressive decoding to fit large models on memory-constrained laptops.

projects.name: Middleout Lattice
projects.desc: Multi-Scale Context-Predictive Range Coder (MS-CPRC) lossless compression engine beating Zstd L22 and Brotli L11.
projects.long: High-performance C++ entropy coder combining multi-scale context modeling with predictive range coding.

projects.name: StegaChirp
projects.desc: Ultrasonic FSK steganography for WAV files in pure Python with zero numpy or scipy dependencies.
projects.long: Encodes and decodes hidden payloads in ultrasonic frequency-shift keyed audio carriers.

projects.name: Unlimited OCR
projects.desc: Zero-Cloud, 100% local offline desktop OCR application with Electron UI and ONNX high-precision engine.
projects.long: Air-gapped document intelligence processing high-volume filings and tables with zero outbound network calls.

projects.name: Attempt 3D Engine
projects.desc: From-scratch 3D game engine and zombie survival FPS in pure C++ (398KB executable, zero external frameworks).
projects.long: Pure software rasterizer with custom 3D math library, perspective-correct texturing, and Z-buffering.

projects.name: KernelWeave
projects.desc: Self-compiling skill kernels for LLMs.
projects.long: Synthesizes and caches reusable execution kernels from agent trajectories.

projects.name: SignalHop

projects.name: Nexus

projects.name: Lingua
